verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs Docker images as hardware-isolated VMs in regions close to users over Anycast, and Fly Launch generates Dockerfiles for Go, Rust, Django (Python) and others. That means edge-deployed code in non-JavaScript languages is a first-party capability. However, it is delivered as full VMs or containers, not as a lightweight edge-function abstraction, and no Python runtime is documented beyond the Django framework mention. missing for 10: a function-style (per-request, serverless-function) edge programming model, explicit per-language edge runtime docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-language edge workloads.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust
